methanol: median |error| 7.0% over 150 FLEX tests (range of signed error [-16.7, 32.7] %), held-out 6.3%; baseline constant K 0.497 mm2/s: held-out 18.4% (limit <= 30%)
baseline reported beside S1-K-hep and S1-K-meth
balanced accuracy 0.64 [0.48, 0.74] on 108 held-out tests (tuned G=0.01, T_lim=1725 K on 98 tests); always-one-class baseline 0.50 (limit >= 0.65)
median |error| 30% on 38 held-out tests; measured value inside model range in 82% (limit <= 35%)
0 g, no flow: worst (max - min radius)/mean radius 0.0e+00 over 20 cases (limit < 1%)
aspect ratio does not decrease from 0 g to Moon to Mars to 1 g at zero forced flow, in every fuel/O2/pressure case
model / Roper: methane 173.3/66.6 mm = 2.60, ethylene 219.0/98.3 mm = 2.23, propane 453.1/161.6 mm = 2.80 (limit 0.5 to 2.0)
standoff 0 g / 1 g at 0.05 m/s: 4.21 to 8.71 along the plate (limit > 1 everywhere)
burning-rate drop from 2 to 20 cm: 0 g at 0.05 m/s 1.33, 0 g at 0.20 m/s 2.67, 1 g at 0.05 m/s 4.32 g/m2/s (0 g low flow must be smallest)

Ananth, Ndubizu & Tatem, 'Flow past a bu: model 3.905 vs reported [4.0, 4.0]; Ndubizu, Ananth & Tatem, Halon Options T: model 20.662 vs reported [18.2, 18.2]; Singh, PhD thesis, Univ. of Maryland 201: model 6.836 vs reported [5.99, 5.99]; Singh, PhD thesis 2015, Table 8: PMMA 7.: model 11.039 vs reported [7.84, 7.84]; Singh, PhD thesis 2015, Ch. 5 (vertical : model 8.945 vs reported [8.9, 8.9] (limit: inside the reported range widened x2 each side)
